summary: SYNTHETIC. A mill payroll vanished from an unforced safe overnight in November 1954. Police alleged the bookkeeper opened it; he was charged, tried, and acquitted in March 1955. The money had not been recovered as of April 1955.

openQuestions.question: Who removed the payroll from the safe?
When exactly was the office light seen: about 2 a.m. or shortly after midnight?
Was anyone else ever investigated or charged?

contradictions.description: Trial testimony places the light at about 2 a.m.; the next-day newspaper said shortly after midnight.
A listicle says the case ended in a jail sentence; the court record shows an acquittal.
contradictions.resolution: Court record prevails. The listicle is DISCOVERY_ONLY.
